title: Trials and Peter's Denial

scenes.title: Before the High Priest
scenes.note: That night and the next morning Jesus was questioned several times: by Annas, by Caiaphas and the council, by Pilate, and by Herod (Luke 23:6-12). This chapter shows only some of them.

bsb: But Jesus remained silent. Then the high priest said to Him,
kjv: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him,

bsb: I charge You under oath by the living God: Tell us if You are the Christ, the Son of God.
kjv: I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.

bsb: You have said it yourself
But I say to all of you, from now on you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of heaven.
kjv: Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The council said Jesus deserved to die. Then they mocked Him and struck Him.

puzzle.prompt: When the high priest asked if He was the Christ, what did Jesus say?
puzzle.hint: Jesus told the truth, even though it would cost Him.

bsb: Meanwhile, Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, and a servant girl came up to him.
kjv: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying,

bsb: You also were with Jesus the Galilean
kjv: Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.

bsb: I do not know what you are talking about.
kjv: I know not what thou sayest.

bsb: This man was with Jesus of Nazareth.
kjv: This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.

bsb: I do not know the man!
kjv: I do not know the man.

bsb: Surely you are one of them
for your accent gives you away.
kjv: Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.

bsb: I do not know the man!
kjv: I know not the man.

bsb: And immediately a rooster crowed.
kjv: And immediately the cock crew.

puzzle.prompt: Peter was afraid, and he said he didn't know Jesus.
puzzle.question: How many times did Peter deny knowing Jesus?
puzzle.hint: Jesus had said, “before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.”

bsb: I have sinned by betraying innocent blood
kjv: I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood.

bsb: Are You the King of the Jews?
kjv: Art thou the King of the Jews?

bsb: My kingdom is not of this world; if it were, My servants would fight to prevent My arrest by the Jews. But now My kingdom is not of this realm.
kjv: My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

bsb: Then You are a king!
kjv: Art thou a king then?

bsb: You say that I am a king
For this reason I was born and have come into the world, to testify to the truth. Everyone who belongs to the truth listens to My voice.
kjv: Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

bsb: What is truth?
kjv: What is truth?

bsb: I find no basis for a charge against Him.
kjv: I find in him no fault at all.

bsb: What then should I do with Jesus who is called Christ?
kjv: What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ?

bsb: Crucify Him!
kjv: Let him be crucified.

bsb: I do not know the man!
kjv: I do not know the man.

bsb: What is truth?
kjv: What is truth?

bsb: My kingdom is not of this world
kjv: My kingdom is not of this world

puzzle.hint: One was a frightened disciple; one was the Roman governor.

bsb: Everyone who belongs to the truth listens to My voice.
kjv: Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

reflect: Jesus stayed silent and truthful while others lied. Peter failed Him, but Peter's story was not over.
discuss: Why do you think Peter said he didn't know Jesus?
Peter wept bitterly when the rooster crowed. Have you ever felt sorry for letting someone down?
Pilate said Jesus had done nothing wrong, but handed Him over anyway. Why is it important to do what is right even when a crowd disagrees?
prayer: Jesus, You stayed true when others failed You. When we are afraid, help us be brave and not deny You. Amen.
